def process(normalize_violations) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = normalize_violations.copy()
    
    # Calculate exceedance rate per beach per year
    stats = df.groupby(['Beach Name', 'Year']).agg(
        total_tests=('Violation', 'size'),
        violations=('Violation', lambda x: (x == 'YES').sum())
    ).reset_index()
    
    stats['exceedance_rate'] = stats['violations'] / stats['total_tests']
    
    return stats
